name: Renata Glasc, Chem-Baroness
howItPlays: You hold battlefields early to pile up Gold gear tokens, racing to get close to the score you need to win because every Gold token starts pumping out extra energy once you're within three points of it. That flood of energy lets you dump your whole hand in one turn late in the game, turning a close scoreline into a sudden win.
whyYou: You like starting fast and racing your opponent to the finish line, then cashing in everything you've built for one huge turn. You're comfortable with a plan that can look shaky early and only makes sense once the pieces click together, and you enjoy the risk of a game that can swing hard in either direction. If you'd rather gamble on a big finish than grind out a slow steady win, Renata Glasc is your Legend.
ratingNotes: pace 5.5: riftbound.gg says 'a hot start is instrumental for this legend to thrive' and the deck focuses on 'proactive synergies, and ways to quickly get on the board' to reach the 5-point Gold energy bonus fast; cardsrealm's build also aims to close 'out of nowhere' once it's ready, so it isn't a pure race but it wants an early lead. stance 6.5: riftbound.gg describes the deck as 'built around strong standalone cards first and foremost' using 'the best proactive patterns available in her domains', though it can 'adapt' into a more control-heavy list depending on matchup; cardsrealm's build hoards Gold tokens patiently before its big turn, so this is proactive on balance rather than extreme. complexity 8.5: cardsrealm asks outright 'could this Renata list be the most difficult list to pilot in the game?', citing the need to track Gold tokens and the score threshold where 'each ready Gold supplies an Energy as well'; the hardest deck in this batch to pilot. variance 7.5: cardsrealm says the deck 'can win out of nowhere' off a big Time Warp turn but also 'struggles early' and needs specific pieces to come together, a genuine high-ceiling, low-floor swing. Legend ability: when you or an ally hold, you may exhaust Renata to play a Gold gear token exhausted; while your score is within 3 points of the Victory Score, your Gold tokens add an extra Energy 1. Confidence: medium; three sources agree on the shape but the archetype label varies (riftbound.gg calls it proactive/adaptive, hextechanalytics' Industrialist build wins through units on the ground, cardsrealm calls its own build close to a one-turn finish); went with Combo given the explicit score-threshold payoff turn and cardsrealm's own framing. Competitively cardsrealm rates it Tier 5, the weakest legend they cover, which the reviewer should weigh against fielding it as a Match at all.
